get_device_of_module: get the CUDA or CPU device of a PyTorch module by inspecting its parameters
get_pearl_device_by_id: get a PyTorch device for a given CUDA ID or the current distributed rank
check_distribution_enabled: check if PyTorch distributed is initialized and available for multi-GPU training
get_default_torch_device: get the default PyTorch device where factory methods place tensors without explicit device
handle_device_not_found_error: handle the DeviceNotFoundInModuleError raised when a module has no parameters or sub-modules
